correctness.rationale: Normal forms in Dic_4n separate rotations and outside coset. Exact formal-collision counting yields |AA|=r(r+1)/2+s(s−1)+1+2rs (s>0), |AA⁻¹|=1+k(k−1), and pure rotation exception. Nonforced modular affine coincidences involve a nonzero coefficient of magnitude at most 2 and have probability O_k(1/n); fixed-size hypergeometric rotation count converges to Binomial(k,1/2). At k=6 the positive numerator 21 is smaller than negative 22; monotonicity proves all k>=6. Independently checked direct group products for n=2,3,4 and k up to 6 and the binomial inequality.
residual_risks: All error bounds require fixed k and n→∞; no growing-k statement.
Potential alternate earlier terminology for nonsplit dicyclic MSTD/MDTS remains possible.
